# cloudinary_trigger (Data Source)

Reads a Cloudinary trigger from a product environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Either trigger_id or uri identifies the trigger.
data "cloudinary_trigger" "uploaded" {
  product_environment = "acme-prod"
  uri                 = "https://example.com/webhooks/uploaded"
}

output "event_type" {
  value = data.cloudinary_trigger.uploaded.event_type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product_environment` (String) The ID or cloud name of the product environment to read from.

### Optional

- `access_key` (String) The name of the access key to authenticate with. Defaults to the root key.
- `trigger_id` (String) The ID of the trigger to look up. Either this or `uri` must be set.
- `uri` (String) The endpoint notifications are delivered to. May be used to look the trigger up instead of `trigger_id`.

### Read-Only

- `additive` (Boolean) Whether the trigger is delivered in addition to any globally configured notification URL.
- `created_at` (String) When the trigger was created.
- `event_type` (String) The event that fires the trigger.
- `filter` (String) JSON-encoded filter restricting which events fire the trigger.
- `filter_language` (String) The language the `filter` expression is written in.
- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the form `<cloud_name>/<trigger_id>`.
- `payload_template` (String) JSON-encoded template shaping the notification payload.
- `updated_at` (String) When the trigger was last updated.
- `uri_type` (String) The transport Cloudinary inferred from `uri`.
